from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """A data point for a specific month extracted from a report."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The month this data applies to (YYYY-MM)")
    single_family_housing_starts: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate for single-family starts")
    five_or_more_unit_starts: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate for starts for buildings with five or more units")
    units_under_construction: float | None = Field(description="Total seasonally adjusted units under construction")

class ConstructionReport(BaseModel):
    """Data extracted from a single monthly statistical release."""
    release_date: str | None = Field(description="The release date of this report (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM)")
    report_identifier: str | None = Field(description="Document identifier if available (e.g. Release Number CB22-156)")
    data_points: list[MonthlyDataPoint] = Field(description="All monthly data points found in this report, including revisions")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    construction_reports: list[ConstructionReport]
